works.title: Artificial Intelligence, Aging, and the Macroeconomy: A Life-Cycle General Equilibrium Model with Endogenous Fertility, AI Capital, and Longevity
works.abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium overlapping-generations model with endogenous fertility, in which firms accumulate both physical and artificial intelligence capital, and uses it to study the macroeconomic transmission of two structural disturbances, an AI technology shock and a longevity shock.
